title: Fix released gameplay tool-protocol mismatch
description: Native Windows v0.1.1 smoke proved the packaged CLI can invoke the model, but the first gameplay turn responded that DM tools described in the instructions ('roll', 'world_query', 'mark_scene', etc.) are not present in the available toolset. This means the released gameplay loop is not exposing or describing tools consistently. Fix the model/tool protocol so live gameplay turns either receive the intended callable tools via the Claude Agent SDK or are prompted to use the current fenced-text tool protocol without claiming native tools are unavailable. Add a live/fake-model regression that fails if the assistant responds with unavailable-tool disclaimers on the first normal turn. Acceptance: a deferred-character smoke turn produces in-world narration or an appropriate deterministic tool request, not a meta-tooling complaint.
notes: Reworked on PR #241 (branch fix/eznk-native-tools) to the SUPPORTED Agent SDK in-process MCP path. New AgentSdkMcpModelClient: ModelToolDefinition[] -> tool()+createSdkMcpServer({name:'eshyra'}); handlers delegate to deterministic executor via new ModelCompleteInput.executeTool bridge; complete() returns executedToolCalls recorded as source=native-mcp under Eshyra names. query() gets mcpServers + allowedTools(mcp__eshyra__*) + tools:[] + ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false. Subscription OAuth path needs no API key. Debug toolProtocolMode=agent-sdk-mcp with provided=Eshyra/forwarded=MCP names + server status. AnthropicNativeModelClient kept as API-key-native alt; fenced retained legacy/test only (broad removal=eshyra-qa9d). jsonSchemaToZod.ts converts schema subset to Zod for tool(). zod added as core dep. 1927 tests pass; manual PowerShell live smoke in PR body for user to run. Awaiting review/merge.
close_reason: Merged to main via PR #241 (squash 36670d9): Agent SDK in-process MCP tool exposure, mechanics-audit gate, and explicit subscription-safe provider auth. Live smoke passed.
